title: GraphACM: Graph-based Action Consistency Measurement for Uncertainty Quantification in LLM Agents
title_zh: GraphACM：基于图的行动一致性度量方法，用于 LLM 智能体的不确定性量化

paragraphs.en: Behavioral consistency across repeated executions provides an informative signal for assessing the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents. However, existing approaches typically summarize consistency with a single task-level score, without identifying where behavioral differences occur or whether actions are compared under equivalent decision contexts. We propose a graph-based framework for fine-grained behavioral consistency measurement and uncertainty quantification. Given multiple rollouts of the same task, we merge equivalent states into a directed, action-labeled graph, enabling action comparisons at shared decision states. We introduce node-level and global measures of action consistency, using the global consistency score as a proxy for uncertainty to predict task success or failure. Experiments across three LLMs on ALFWorld, AppWorld, and WebShop demonstrate that our measure is positively associated with task success and achieves an average AUROC of 0.811 for task-success prediction, outperforming the strongest behavioral-consistency baseline (0.729) and verbalized confidence (0.769). These results highlight the effectiveness of state-conditioned behavioral consistency and pinpoint where agent actions agree.
paragraphs.zh: 在重复执行过程中保持行为一致性，为评估大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的可靠性提供了有价值的信号。 然而，现有方法通常仅用单一的任务级分数来概括一致性，并未识别行为差异出现的具体位置，也未明确相关动作是否是在等效的决策情境下进行比较的。 我们提出了一种基于图的框架，用于实现精细化的行为一致性测量与不确定性量化。 在给定同一任务的多轮执行结果后，我们将等效状态合并为一个带有动作标签的有向图，从而能够在共享的决策状态下对动作进行比较。 我们引入了节点级和全局级的动作一致性度量方法，并利用全局一致性分数作为不确定性的代理指标来预测任务的成功或失败。 在 ALFWorld、AppWorld 和 WebShop 平台上对三种 LLM 进行的实验表明，我们的度量方法与任务成功呈正相关，并在任务成功预测中实现了 0.811 的平均 AUROC，优于最强的行为一致性基线方法（0.729）和语言化置信度方法（0.769）。 这些结果凸显了状态条件化行为一致性方法的有效性，并精准定位了智能体动作一致的具体位置。

paragraphs.en: As agents move toward real-world deployment, how to evaluate them and when to trust them remain open challenges ( Kapoor et al., 2025 ; Kirchhof et al., 2025 ) . Evaluating task success based on the final outcome is a standard approach, but it reveals little about the intermediate action behavior or whether the agent would succeed again on the same task. Recent work therefore studies behavioral consistency , which measures the degree to which an agent behaves similarly across repeated executions of the same task. Behavioral consistency has been used as a signal of reliability ( Rabanser et al., 2026 ) , with higher consistency indicating greater reliability. It can also be used for uncertainty quantification ( Mehta, 2026 ) : the more the executions agree, the more confidence the agent’s behavior warrants.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体向真实世界部署迈进，如何评估它们以及何时可以信任它们仍然是待解决的挑战（Kapoor 等人，2025；Kirchhof 等人，2025）。 根据最终结果来评估任务成功与否是一种标准方法，但这几乎无法揭示中间阶段的行动行为，也无法说明该智能体在执行同一任务时是否还会成功。 因此，近期的研究开始关注行为一致性，即衡量智能体在重复执行同一任务时其行为相似性的程度。 行为一致性已被用作可靠性的指标（Rabanser 等人，2026），一致性越高表示可靠性越强。 它也可以用于不确定性量化（Mehta，2026）：执行结果越一致，智能体的行为就越值得信赖。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches typically compare behavioral consistency at the outcome or sequence level. Outcome-level consistency assess agreement among final outputs without characterizing intermediate decisions ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . Sequence-level consistency quantify agreement across complete action sequences, such as counting the number of unique sequences ( Mehta, 2026 ) or computing Discrete Semantic Entropy (DSE) over clusters of identical sequences ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Such exact-match measures treat sequences differing by even a single inserted action as distinct, making them sensitive to minor shifts in action sequences. Other methods allow partial agreement: Tool Sequence Similarity (TSS) uses edit-based similarity between tool-name sequences, while Argument Consistency (AC) compares arguments of step-aligned tool calls ( Yagubyan, 2026 ) . Action-Set Consistency (ASC) and Action-Distribution Consistency (ADC) discard temporal order by comparing action-type sets and frequency distributions, respectively ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通常在结果或序列层面比较行为一致性。 结果层面的一致性评估最终输出之间的一致性，但未描述中间决策（Yao 等，2025）。 序列层面的一致性衡量完整动作序列之间的一致性，例如统计唯一序列的数量（Mehta，2026），或对相同序列的簇计算离散语义熵（DSE）（Ye 等，2026）。 这类精确匹配方法将仅因插入一个动作而不同的序列视为不同，因此对动作序列中的微小变化非常敏感。 其他方法允许部分一致：工具序列相似性（TSS）使用基于编辑的工具名称序列相似性度量，而参数一致性（AC）则比较步骤对齐的工具调用的参数（Yagubyan，2026）。 动作集合一致性（ASC）和动作分布一致性（ADC）分别通过比较动作类型的集合和频率分布来忽略时间顺序（Bouchard 和 Chauhan，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Despite these differences, existing approaches leave two important gaps. First, they primarily summarize behavioral consistency with a single task-level score, without identifying the intermediate decisions at which executions agree or diverge. Second, they establish action correspondence through sequence position or aggregate statistics, rather than the decision contexts in which actions were selected. Actions at the same step may respond to different situations, while equivalent situations may arise at different steps. Although repeated executions begin from the same initial environment, once trajectories diverge, their subsequent actions are no longer taken under the same conditions. Consequently, comparing actions without accounting for their source states can conflate differences in encountered situations with differences in the agent’s decision-making behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这些差异，现有方法仍然存在两个重要的空白。 首先，它们主要通过单一的任务级分数来概括行为一致性，而未能识别出执行过程中出现一致或分歧的中间决策。 其次，它们通过序列位置或汇总统计信息来建立动作对应关系，而非基于动作被选择时的决策上下文。 同一步骤中的动作可能针对不同的情况作出响应，而相同的情况也可能出现在不同步骤中。 尽管重复执行从相同的初始环境开始，但一旦轨迹发生分歧，其后续的动作便不再处于相同的条件下执行。 因此，如果不考虑动作的来源状态而直接比较动作，可能会将所遇到情况的差异与智能体决策行为的差异混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: Recent graph-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods have demonstrated the value of aggregating agent trajectories through shared states. GraphGPO ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) and G2PO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) construct state-transition graphs by merging equivalent states across rollouts, with actions represented as transitions. These graphs support fine-grained credit assignment and advantage estimation for policy optimization. Although these methods also leverage multiple sampled trajectories, their objective is to optimize agent policies through training, whereas ours is to measure the behavioral consistency of a fixed agent at inference time without requiring outcome labels.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的基于图的强化学习（RL）方法已经证明了通过共享状态聚合智能体轨迹的价值。 GraphGPO（Cheng 等人，2026）和 G2PO（Wang 等人，2026）通过合并不同展开过程中的等效状态来构建状态转换图，其中动作被表示为转换。 这些图支持精细的信用分配和优势估计，从而用于策略优化。 尽管这些方法也利用了多个采样轨迹，但它们的目标是通过训练优化智能体策略，而我们的目标则是在推理阶段测量固定智能体的行为一致性，且无需结果标签。

paragraphs.en: Our method provides a fine-grained, state-aligned measure of behavioral consistency by comparing actions taken from equivalent states across repeated rollouts. A graph naturally supports this comparison by merging equivalent states into shared nodes and representing actions as labeled edges, revealing where trajectories share states and where their actions diverge. We first describe the graph construction, then introduce node-level and task-level action consistency measures, followed by uncertainty quantification and theoretical analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法通过比较重复运行中来自等效状态的动作，提供了一种精细且与状态对齐的行为一致性度量。 图结构天然支持这种比较：它将等效状态合并为共享节点，并将动作表示为带标签的边，从而揭示出哪些轨迹共享了相同状态，以及它们在这些状态上的动作存在差异之处。 我们首先描述图的构建过程，然后引入节点级和任务级的动作一致性度量，接着进行不确定性量化和理论分析。

paragraphs.en: We examine the relationship between global action consistency and task success rate. For each task–model pair, we sample k = 10 k=10 trajectories and define the success rate as the fraction that succeed. Figure 3 presents results for four model–benchmark pairs; all nine are reported in Figure 7 in Appendix. On ALFWorld and AppWorld, consistency is positively associated with success rate across all six pairs (Spearman’s ρ = 0.80 \rho=0.80 – 0.83 0.83 on ALFWorld and 0.57 0.57 – 0.74 0.74 on AppWorld). The increase is most pronounced at high success rates, suggesting that consistency is particularly informative for distinguishing reliably solved tasks from those solved less consistently. On WebShop, the association is weaker ( ρ = 0.25 \rho=0.25 – 0.40 0.40 ), with some zero-success tasks exhibiting high consistency, as analyzed in Appendix D.2 . Overall, the positive associations across all nine pairs support consistency as a behavioral indicator of empirical task reliability.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares the AUROC of our consistency measure with all baselines. Our method achieves the highest average AUROC, 0.811 0.811 , exceeding verbalized confidence (VC, 0.769 0.769 ) and the strongest consistency baseline (AC, 0.729 0.729 ). It ranks first or tied-first in six of the nine settings and second in the remaining three. Besides, the results show that no consistency-based baseline performs uniformly strong. The sequence-based measures (TSS, AC, ASC, ADC) perform best overall on AppWorld but vary widely on ALFWorld and are weaker on WebShop, where TSS performs near chance and ASC is at chance. The count-based measures (UAS and DSE) exhibit the opposite pattern: relatively strong performance on ALFWorld and WebShop but near-chance performance on AppWorld. In contrast, our method achieves the highest or second-highest AUROC in every setting, maintaining consistently strong performance across all settings.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 比较了我们的一致性度量与所有基线方法的 AUROC。 我们的方法获得了最高的平均 AUROC（0.811），超过了言语化置信度（VC，0.769）和最强的基线一致性方法（AC，0.729）。 在九个设置中，该方法有六个设置排名第一或并列第一，其余三个设置为第二。 此外，结果表明没有任何基于一致性的基线方法能表现出稳定且强劲的性能。 序列类度量（TSS、AC、ASC、ADC）在 AppWorld 上的整体表现最佳，但在 ALFWorld 上的表现差异较大，并且在 WebShop 上较弱，其中 TSS 的表现接近随机水平，而 ASC 则处于随机水平。 计数类度量（UAS 和 DSE）则呈现出相反的模式：在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的表现相对较强，但在 AppWorld 上的表现接近随机水平。 相比之下，我们的方法在每个设置中都获得了最高或第二高的 AUROC，在所有设置中均保持了稳定且强劲的性能。

paragraphs.en: Overall scores are lower on WebShop than on the other benchmarks, suggesting that WebShop is the most challenging benchmark for predicting success from consistency, align our findings in Section 3.3 and Figure 4 . One possible reason could be that its episodes are short and follow a fixed skeleton: search, click a product, select options, buy. This means even unsuccessful rollouts may traverse similar steps and exhibit high consistency.

paragraphs.en: Recent RL methods leverage shared states and transitions across rollouts to improve step-level credit assignment. GiGPO groups actions from repeated environment states for relative-advantage estimation ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . Graph-based methods further organize rollouts into shared structures. GraphGPO constructs a unified state-transition graph and assigns edge credit based on estimated progress toward the goal ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , while G2PO merges identical observations into shared nodes and estimates edge advantages using aggregated state values ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . GEPO merges semantically similar observations using sentence embeddings for graph-based credit assignment ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . SALT incorporates recent action–observation history into state representations and merges transitions sharing the same source state, action, and successor state ( Li et al., 2026 ) . While these methods use shared state structures for reward-based policy optimization, our work constructs graphs to measure the behavioral consistency of fixed agents across rollouts, without requiring outcome labels at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的强化学习方法利用多次 rollout 过程中共享的状态和状态转移，以改进单步信用分配。 GiGPO 将来自重复环境状态的动作进行分组，用于相对优势估计（Feng 等，2026）。 基于图的方法进一步将 rollout 组织为共享结构。 GraphGPO 构建一个统一的状态转移图，并根据向目标推进的估计进度分配边信用（Cheng 等，2026），而 G2PO 则将相同的观测合并为共享节点，并使用聚合状态值估计边优势（Wang 等，2026）。 GEPO 利用句子嵌入将语义相似的观测合并，以实现基于图的信用分配（Yuan 等，2025）。 SALT 将最近的动作-观测历史纳入状态表示，并合并共享相同源状态、动作和后续状态的状态转移（Li 等，2026）。 尽管这些方法使用共享状态结构进行基于奖励的策略优化，但我们的工作则是构建图来衡量固定智能体在多次 rollout 中的行为一致性，且无需在推理阶段提供结果标签。

paragraphs.en: UQ for LLM agents have built on approaches developed for LLMs, including probability-based scores, verbalized confidence, and sample consistency ( Kuhn et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Oh et al., 2026 ) . Agentic settings introduce additional challenges from function calls and multi-step interactions. UProp separates uncertainty intrinsic to a decision from uncertainty inherited from earlier decisions ( Duan et al., 2025 ) , while SAUP aggregates step-level uncertainty using situation-aware weights ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) . UOPD utilize model confidence to identify intervention turns ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . TRACER combines token surprisal with behavioral signals to identify high-risk episodes ( Tayebati et al., 2026 ) . Oh et al. (2026) represent trajectories as a dynamic Bayesian network over actions, states, and observations. RUPA propagates uncertainty along temporal and semantic dependencies in a trajectory graph ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , while PropUQ-MAS combines local uncertainty with uncertainty inherited through inter-agent communication ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Rather than propagating uncertainty through execution dependencies, we quantify uncertainty using action agreement across repeated rollouts.

paragraphs.en: Behavioral consistency has gained attention as an important dimension of agent reliability and uncertainty quantification. Rabanser et al. (2026) distinguish outcome, trajectory, and consistency within a broader reliability framework. Existing methods measure consistency across repeated executions through action sequence diversity ( Mehta, 2026 ) , discrete semantic entropy over sequence clusters ( Farquhar et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , tool-call sequences ( Yagubyan, 2026 ) , or trajectory-level comparisons ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ) . MATU further examines recurring interaction patterns in multi-agent systems using tensor decomposition ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . While these methods provide valuable insights into agent behavior, existing consistency measures largely rely on sequence-level or aggregate comparisons. In contrast, our work constructs state-action graphs to compare decisions made under equivalent contexts, enabling fine-grained consistency measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 行为一致性作为智能体可靠性和不确定性量化的一个重要维度，已受到广泛关注。Rabanser 等人 (2026) 在一个更广泛的可靠性框架中区分了结果、轨迹和一致性。 现有方法通过动作序列多样性（Mehta, 2026）、序列簇上的离散语义熵（Farquhar 等人, 2024；Ye 等人, 2026）、工具调用序列（Yagubyan, 2026）或轨迹层面的比较（Bouchard 和 Chauhan, 2026）来衡量重复执行中的一致性。 MATU 进一步利用张量分解（Chen 等人, 2026）研究多智能体系统中重复出现的交互模式。 尽管这些方法为理解智能体行为提供了宝贵见解，但现有的一致性度量大多依赖序列层面或汇总层面的比较。 相比之下，我们的研究构建了状态-动作图，以比较在等效情境下做出的决策，从而实现精细的一致性测量。

sents.en: Existing methods measure consistency across repeated executions through action sequence diversity ( Mehta, 2026 ) , discrete semantic entropy over sequence clusters ( Farquhar et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , tool-call sequences ( Yagubyan, 2026 ) , or trajectory-level comparisons ( Bouchard and Chauhan, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 现有方法通过动作序列多样性（Mehta, 2026）、序列簇上的离散语义熵（Farquhar 等人, 2024；Ye 等人, 2026）、工具调用序列（Yagubyan, 2026）或轨迹层面的比较（Bouchard 和 Chauhan, 2026）来衡量重复执行中的一致性。

sents.en: MATU further examines recurring interaction patterns in multi-agent systems using tensor decomposition ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: MATU 进一步利用张量分解（Chen 等人, 2026）研究多智能体系统中重复出现的交互模式。

sents.en: While these methods provide valuable insights into agent behavior, existing consistency measures largely rely on sequence-level or aggregate comparisons.
sents.zh: 尽管这些方法为理解智能体行为提供了宝贵见解，但现有的一致性度量大多依赖序列层面或汇总层面的比较。

sents.en: In contrast, our work constructs state-action graphs to compare decisions made under equivalent contexts, enabling fine-grained consistency measurements.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们的研究构建了状态-动作图，以比较在等效情境下做出的决策，从而实现精细的一致性测量。

paragraphs.en: We presented GraphACM, a graph-based framework for measuring behavioral consistency and quantifying uncertainty in LLM agents. By merging repeated executions into a shared state-transition graph, our method enables action comparisons under comparable decision contexts. We introduced node-level and global action consistency measures, supporting both fine-grained behavioral analysis and task-level uncertainty estimation. Experiments across three LLMs and three agent benchmarks demonstrate a positive association between behavioral consistency and task success. Our method also outperforms existing behavioral-consistency baselines and verbalized confidence in average task-success prediction performance. These findings highlight the effectiveness of state-conditioned behavioral consistency as an interpretable, training-free signal for assessing agent reliability and quantifying uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GraphACM，这是一个基于图的框架，用于衡量 LLM 智能体的行为一致性并量化其不确定性。 通过将重复执行合并为共享的状态转换图，我们的方法能够在可比较的决策上下文中对动作进行比较。 我们引入了节点级和全局的动作一致性度量方法，既支持精细的行为分析，也支持任务级的不确定性估计。 在三种 LLM 和三种智能体基准测试上进行的实验表明，行为一致性与任务成功之间存在正向关联。 我们的方法在平均任务成功预测性能方面也优于现有的行为一致性基线模型和语言化置信度指标。 这些发现凸显了基于状态的行为一致性作为一种可解释且无需训练的信号，在评估智能体可靠性和量化不确定性方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Our framework has several limitations. First, behavioral consistency serves as an indirect indicator of reliability rather than a guarantee of correctness. Agents may consistently repeat incorrect decisions, as observed in some WebShop tasks. This is an inherent limitation shared by consistency-based approaches rather than a limitation specific to our method. Second, the effectiveness of state-aligned comparisons depends on the quality of state abstraction. Incorrectly merging distinct decision contexts or failing to identify equivalent states may affect consistency estimates. Third, our method requires multiple rollouts of the same task, introducing additional inference costs compared with single-execution approaches. Finally, our evaluation is limited to three LLMs and three agent benchmarks. Future work could investigate the sensitivity of our method to the state representations, as well as its generalization to more diverse agent environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架存在若干局限性。 首先，行为一致性只是可靠性的间接指标，而非正确性的保证。 智能体可能会持续重复错误的决策，正如在某些 WebShop 任务中观察到的那样。 这是基于一致性的方法所共有的固有局限性，而非我们方法特有的问题。 其次，状态对齐比较的有效性取决于状态抽象的质量。 错误地合并不同的决策上下文，或未能识别出等效状态，都可能会影响一致性估计。 第三，我们的方法需要对同一任务进行多次执行，与单次执行的方法相比，这会带来额外的推理成本。 最后，我们的评估仅限于三种 LLM 和三种智能体基准测试。 未来的研究可以进一步探讨我们的方法对状态表示的敏感度，以及其在更多样化智能体环境中的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: High behavioral consistency does not guarantee correct or safe behavior and should not be used alone to authorize consequential agent actions. Repeated rollouts also increase computational demands and may increase environmental costs.
paragraphs.zh: 行为高度一致并不保证行为的正确性或安全性，因此不应单独用于授权智能体执行会产生后果的行动。 重复部署也会增加计算需求，并可能提高环境成本。
